title: On Some Problems from the Kourovka Notebook
summary: The Kourovka Notebook is a long-running collection of open problems in group theory. In this paper we present solutions to eight of its problems. We construct a group with exactly two maximal locally soluble normal subgroups and show that, for every $1 \le k\le n!$, there is a group containing $n$ distinct elements whose $n!$ ordered products take exactly $k$ distinct values.
